routines.fixtureRationale: One small handwritten FK produces nontrivial all-axis rotations and angular derivatives without external kernels/data. Other cases write authored pool metadata in isolated workflows. Full32-character NAME is injected directly because FRAME_ prefix plus a long binding key is subject to the32-byte pool variable limit.
routines.cleanup: Each workflow clears/reset kernel state and disposes backend in finally; explicit load/unload observes name/metadata cache invalidation. No cell/file claim is acquired by these eight utilities. Protected WASM string/output buffers free after success/error and all34 injected failures. Scoped oracle found setting restores in finally even on toolkit failure. CK pointing/coverage/handle ownership and remaining allocation gaps stay in frames-1.
routines.tolerance: Live comparator remains1e-12 absolute-or-relative for every rotation/state component. Nonzero derivative values are order1e-3, so accidental zeroing fails. Independent central-difference derivative check uses h=.01s and a separate5e-11 bound for truncation/roundoff at authored rates~1e-3; complete inverse product and repeated rotation blocks use1e-12. Literal IDs/names/metadata compare exactly; no source field is discarded.
